candidates.rigNotes: Original skinned model and all matching exported actions, including facial animation where present.
candidates.caveat: Playback preserves the source clips. Scene dialogue, navigation and gameplay interactions are separate from the model.

candidates.name: Ice Lurker
candidates.pattern: Thirteen actions cover vulnerable walking, emergence, spike extension, committed running, stopping and recovery.
candidates.adaptation: Study the readable change from vulnerable walking to an armoured charge, with a deliberate recovery.
candidates.rigNotes: Inspect each available action on the original rig. Full source geometry, skin weights and animation keys are retained.
candidates.caveat: Source animation playback shows the character’s authored poses. Travel, targeting, damage and encounter effects belong to its gameplay controller.
